units.title: Why geometric Langlands wants 4d QFT
units.summary: Witten motivates attaching a category of boundary conditions on a closed surface (2-manifold) to a 4d quantum field theory: geometric Langlands assigns categories to a Riemann surface, matching the dimensional pattern of QFT boundary categories.

units.title: N=4 SYM as the natural theory
units.summary: The theory with maximal supersymmetry in 4d—N=4 super Yang–Mills—is identified as the natural home: gauge group G (compact Lie), dual group G∨ appears via S-duality later in the story; differential from supersymmetry packages geometric Langlands structure.

units.title: Mirror symmetry meets Hitchin / Langlands
units.summary: Talk bridges mirror symmetry language (branes, dual geometries) with geometric Langlands on moduli of bundles / Hitchin-type data; treat as culture and dictionary, not a board proof of HMS or GLC.
